biggest_catch: The $500 tier is the Elite Checking account: you must route $2,500 in direct deposits in EACH of the first three 30-day windows ($7,500 total), the account charges a $15 monthly fee unless you hold $25,000 in it, and closing within 180 days can trigger a closure fee plus bonus reclamation.
catches: Two tiers: $300 for Flagstar Ready Checking (at least $500 in direct deposits during EACH of the three consecutive 30-day timeframes, $1,500 cumulative) or $500 for Flagstar Elite Checking (at least $2,500 in each 30-day timeframe, $7,500 cumulative), all within the first 90 days after account opening.
'Direct deposit' means an electronic ACH deposit of your paycheck, pension, Social Security, or other regular monthly income.
Must be a new personal checking customer of Flagstar Bank; if any signer on the account has previously been paid a checking cash bonus, you are ineligible.
Bonus paid 91–104 days after account opening.
Limited to one promotion per household; cannot be combined with any other offers or promotions.
Early account closure fee and reclamation of the bonus may be imposed for accounts closed within 180 days.
Flagstar Bank employees are not eligible; area restrictions may apply.
Elite Checking carries a $15 monthly fee unless you hold $25,000 in the account; Ready Checking is fee-free with eStatements.
Offer subject to change or cancellation at any time without notice; bonus is taxable as interest income (1099).

steps: Open a new Flagstar personal checking account — Ready Checking for the $300 tier or Elite Checking for the $500 tier.

Within the first 90 days after account opening, receive ACH direct deposits (paycheck, pension, Social Security, or other regular monthly income) totaling at least $500 during EACH of the three consecutive 30-day timeframes (days 1–30, 31–60, 61–90) for the $300 Ready tier, or at least $2,500 per timeframe for the $500 Elite tier.
Keep the account open at least 180 days to avoid an early account closure fee and bonus reclamation.
The bonus ($300 into Ready Checking or $500 into Elite Checking) is credited 91–104 days after account opening.
